spans.s: शैनेय, probably शिनि + एय, m. Satyaki, the charioteer of Kṛṣṇa,

सैंह, i. e. सिंह + अ, adj., f. ही,
 1. Inherent in a lion, Hit. i. d. 174. M.
. Lion-like.

सैंहिक,
 I. i. e. सिंह + इक, [] adj. Lion-like.
 II. i. e. सिंहिका + अ, metronym., m. Rāhu.
सैंहिकेय, i. e. सिंहिका + एय, metronym., m. Rāhu.
सैनापत्य, i. e. सेना-पति + य, n. The command of an army,
; generalship, Vikr. d. 161.

सैनिक, i. e. सेना + इक,
 I. adj. Belonging or relating to an army.
 II. m.
 1. A soldier, Hit. ii. d. 82;

. A guard, a picket.
 3. A body of forces in array.

सैन्धव, i. e. सिन्धु + अ,
 I. adj.
 1.

Marine.
 2
. Produced or born in Sindh, Johns.

.
 II. m. and n. Rock-salt.
 III. m.
 1. A horse.
 2. pl. The people of the country along the Indus,
Draup. 6, 6
सैन्धव + क, adj. Relating to the Saindhavas (see the last); with नृप, their king,
Draup. 8, 42

सैन्य, i. e. सेना + य,
 I. m.
 1. A soldier,

. A guard.
 II. n. An army, Hit. iii. d. 79.
 --Comp.
